status.label: Band Breaker
status.tagline: Intraday index momentum: a band of normal noise around the open; a half-hour close outside it is the trade; stop at the far band or VWAP; flat before the close.
status.rule: average noise of the last 14 sessions; checks every 30 min from 10:00; at most 3 entries a day per market; 10 at the stop
